acceptanceCriteria: Both waits ignore si_code 4..6 reports and return only on a real exit; a focused test per package SIGSTOPs a child, asserts the wait does not return, then SIGCONT/kills it and asserts the wait returns without reaping.
body: Found during V1-1037 (lane 2026-10-09, base 986cec7c). internal/dashboard/repository/process_wait_darwin.go (~line 73) and internal/testsupport/pipedrain_unix.go (~line 122) call waitid(P_PID, WEXITED|WNOWAIT) and treat any errno 0 as exit. On Darwin waitid can report a stopped/continued/trapped child (si_code 4..6) despite WEXITED (golang/go#19314). groupreap (stateChangeOnly) and, after V1-1037, procgroup poll past those reports; these two copies do not, so a SIGSTOPped child is treated as exited. Confirmed by code inspection; no runtime reproduction yet.

completion.reason: Delivered in batch P (PR beamfall/corvint#704, merged 2026-10-09 at main dd90cfa6): the Darwin dashboard process waitid state-change fix with review fix; independent review PASS; focused tests passed; CEM bound and sealed. Limits are retained in the lane and batch build logs (Linux amd64 NOT_RUN).

title: Dashboard and testsupport waitid waits treat a Darwin stop/continue report as an exit
